canonical_project: Vantage OH2 / Millersport campus / Fairfield Energy Center
aliases: Vantage OH2 / Millersport campus / Fairfield Energy Center

location.address_or_intersection: NE corner of SR 204 and SR 37 / intersection of Lancaster Newark Road and Blacklick Road

actions.exact_result_status: RPC minutes record a motion to approve the Village of Millersport MOU for plan review of approximately 496 acres after annexation; motion passed. The minutes do not publish a numeric vote tally.
actions.access_caveat: Planning/plan-review coordination is not a data-center building permit.

actions.body: Fairfield County Board of Commissioners / Village of Millersport / Vantage Data Centers
actions.exact_result_status: Official county packet contains the development agreement for one or more data centers and power facilities, with 15-year 100% CRA and enterprise-zone abatements and a 30-year TIF described in the agreement.
actions.access_caveat: The indexed PDF contains agreement text; the exact adopting resolution number and roll call were not visible in the accessible extract.

actions.exact_result_status: County meeting materials identify resolutions concerning an Enterprise Zone agreement with Vantage and a related escrow agreement with the Village, North Valley Bank, and Vantage; numeric vote tally was not located.
actions.access_caveat: The official county minutes are accessible but the indexed text does not expose each resolution number/result line.

actions.exact_result_status: County minutes discuss the enterprise agreement as allowing Vantage to power the data center without taking electricity from the grid and identify the related escrow and Ohio Power road-use resolutions; this is utility/development context, not a building permit.
actions.access_caveat: The accessible minutes summary does not provide a numeric tally for the data-center-related resolutions.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA Construction NOI Storm Water General Permit List report dated 2026-08-10 lists permit 4GC10971*AG for VDC OH-E, operator Kokosing, at the NE corner SR 204 and SR 37 intersection in Millersport, with 476.26 acres.
actions.access_caveat: Stormwater NOI corroborates site disturbance/construction coverage but is not a building occupancy or energization record.

actions.body: Fairfield Energy Center, LLC / Ohio Power Siting Board process
actions.exact_result_status: First public information meeting noticed for the proposed Fairfield Energy Center major utility facility at Millersport High School, 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. EST.
actions.access_caveat: Developer project page; use with OPSB docket/status sources for regulatory status.

actions.body: Fairfield Energy Center, LLC / Ohio Power Siting Board process
actions.exact_result_status: Second public information meeting noticed for the proposed Fairfield Energy Center, including update on OPSB and other regulatory status.
actions.access_caveat: Developer project page; use with OPSB docket/status sources for regulatory status.

actions.exact_result_status: OPSB Battery Storage Case Status map/statistics list Fairfield Energy Center, case 26-0160-EL-BGN, Fairfield County, BTM, 1,040 MW, as a co-located project in pre-application status as of 2026-07-23.
actions.access_caveat: OPSB battery-status map is dated 2026-07-23; the project website says the application has been submitted, so docket status should be rechecked before treating the power plant as approved.

actions.exact_result_status: Vantage Millersport construction updates list May-August 2026 site activity including strip/grade, temporary fencing, access roads, underground storm and utility work, sanitary piping, underground utility installation, and north building pad preparation.
actions.access_caveat: Company construction page; corroborated by Ohio EPA construction stormwater NOI listing for VDC OH-E.

contradictions.topic: Fairfield Energy Center OPSB procedural status
contradictions.details: OPSB Battery Storage Case Status PDF dated 2026-07-23 lists case 26-0160-EL-BGN as pre-application, while Fairfield Energy Center's public-information page states an application has been submitted. Treat the power facility as under OPSB review/pending verification, not approved.
